description: Find articles of Lithuanian codes, laws and Government-approved rules (unofficial mirror of e-tar.lt). Use a reference ("DK 52", "CK 6.228¹", "KET 52") or Lithuanian words ("kasmetinės atostogos"). Returns articles with their URL, whether their text applies today, and for the first 10 the part where the words are (`part`, `snippet`).

act.description: Optional: limit to one act (key, abbreviation or name, e.g. "DK")

query.description: A reference or Lithuanian words (4+ letters each; all must occur). Up to 3 alternative wordings separated by "|" are searched together: "telefono numeris | ryšio duomenys"

name: search_law
